content: Temporal Go SDK: built-in retry policies/timeouts on Activities; Signals push data into a running workflow, persisted in history; Queries read workflow state; workflow.Sleep/Timer for durable timers surviving worker crash; Child Workflows for sub-orchestration with no polling; first-class Saga/compensation support; Versioning APIs required to avoid non-determinism on replay when workflow code changes, plus Worker Versioning for rollout. All of this depends on the Temporal server (external orchestrator) persisting event history and replaying workflow code deterministically.
